data.title: 神裂火织 · 晨光微曦的圣洁人妻依偎
data.description: 清晨的金色阳光透过窗纱洒在被褥上。马尾解开后的黑发如瀑铺散，高挑曼妙的神裂火织像考拉一样紧紧拥着你的腰身，将脸颊埋在你的胸口，嘴角漾着满足安心的甜美笑颜。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with soft white futon
data.action: 像考拉一样紧紧拥着你的腰身，将脸颊埋在你的胸口，嘴角漾着满足安心的甜美笑颜
data.lighting: bright heavenly morning sunlight warming white sheets and smooth skin
data.promptProse: Bathed in warm morning rays filtering through sheer window curtains onto a rumpled futon, Kaori clings affectionately around her partner's torso with her hair loose and her cheek resting happily against his chest.
data.animaCaption: Tangled under golden morning window light with her unbound hair spilling across the futon, she wraps herself closely around her partner's waist and presses her peacefully smiling cheek against his chest in her slipping midnight-indigo silk nightgown.
data.nsfwProse: Her loose midnight-indigo silk slip nightgown with delicate white lace trim hangs relaxed off her bare shoulders beneath the tangled morning sheets.
